title: Golos: Russian Dataset for Speech Research
manual_annotation_evidence: Official repository and Interspeech paper state that recorded Russian audio was manually annotated on a crowdsourcing platform
lineage_decision: Treat Crowd and Farfield as domains of one Golos recording lineage; test partitions are partitions rather than new datasets; acoustic/language models are derived artifacts and not production observations
reason: Primary non-singing Russian speech with human-created transcript annotations; public audio/transcript archives and authoritative checksums are available
counts_known: 1,103,799 train utterances / 1,227.4 h plus 11,910 test utterances / 12.6 h; Crowd 979,796 train + 9,994 test; Farfield 124,003 train + 1,916 test
next_action: Keep large audio archives remote; ingest archive manifests/transcription rows source-faithfully when feasible; preserve domain/split/path/transcript; do not treat models as observations
